Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on monthly bases as indicated in the title block for Battery charger
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El-Bagoury,

This document is 
 updated for 5 years review .
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Caution marks must be hanged on a work place.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable Tool Set
Digital Voltmeter, Brush, Blower.
Work to be Carried Out
Check for correct operation of DC room air condition.
Check ventilation fan of rectifier.
Read input and output voltage and record.
Switch off input and output supply.
Check over heating compartment of rectifier cards.
Check all abnormal cases inside the rectifier.
Inspect visually fuses, contactors, capacitors, rectifier 
card and diodes.
Clean the rectifier from dusty air.
Clean the floor of the DC room
Switch on input and output supply.
Check input and output voltage and record.
